label: DRAFT copy for approval. Leak examples come from Disojo's discovery-first positioning; no stats, no client names.

slides.title: Where your business *leaks* time.
slides.lead: Four places we look first, before we build anything.

slides.label: LEAK 01
slides.title: Bookings that live in *WhatsApp*.
slides.body: Every confirmation, reschedule and “is 5pm free?” is a message someone has to find, read and copy somewhere else.
slides.tell: The tell: someone scrolls chats to know who is coming.

slides.label: LEAK 02
slides.title: Fees tracked in a *spreadsheet*.
slides.body: Who paid, who is late, who showed up. Rebuilt by hand every month, and only one person knows how.
slides.tell: The tell: month-end means a lost evening.

slides.label: LEAK 03
slides.title: Documents typed *twice*.
slides.body: The same details retyped into an invoice, a contract, a form. Every copy is another chance for a mistake.

slides.label: LEAK 04
slides.title: Knowledge in *one head*.
slides.body: If the answer is “ask the one person who knows”, that is a process stored in a person.
slides.tell: The tell: nobody else can cover a holiday.

slides.title: Find the *leak* first.
slides.lead: That is how every Disojo project starts.
